Secret Customer Australia is a National Mystery Shopping and Market Research Company! We already have thousands of happy shoppers but need more in Gwelup, WA and all surrounding suburbs.

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra cash while out and about doing the things you love. Many of our shoppers work with us on a part time basis whilst working their normal jobs while others make a career out of Mystery Shopping by registering with us and other agencies.  The skills you need are simple: 

- A genuine desire to help improve the level of Customer Service in Australia.
- Access to a computer and/or tablet with internet access.
- Intermediate computer skills
- Great attention to detail
- Good memory skills
- Good English writing skills

These particular assignments we are hiring for at the moment are for the Retail Industry  and we have them regularly,  you can do as many or as little as you like.

We do have other industries that we work for such as:

- Hospitality
- Retail Clothing
- Real Estate
- Administration
- Not for Profit
- Hairdressing
- Beauty Salons 
- Retail Flooring
- Outdoor Adventures
- and many many more...

Join the team today and help us make the world a happier place!... yes seriously, that's what we do...  

Join the team and experience the fun and rewarding industry that is mystery shopping! 

We have an online application process we would like you to follow in order to register with us and then be able to start accepting assignments. 

What is the next step?

There are four simple steps to becoming a shopper with us...

1.	Follow this link and register your details on the Secret Customer website https://secret-customer-pty-ltd.clients.app.praemialis.com/registration

2.	Complete the four very simple compliance tests located in the members areas of the website, all tests must be passed at 100% and can be taken as many times as you like.

3.	You will then be emailed instructions on how to complete the online virtual visit using our online reporting system.

4.	Once you have submitted this report it will be reviewed and if accepted you will be sent an email explaining what to do to allow you to start accepting jobs online! If you have any further questions you can call us on 1300 88 33 16 or email us at enquiries @ secretcustomer.com.au 

If you are still not sure, here are some FAQ that may be useful to you:

Why become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra income whist doing the things you already do and enjoy. Your assignments might be to visit a local café or restaurant, cinema, local attraction or another local business. You simply visit your chosen location as you would as a normal paying customer, once you have finished your visit you fill out an online questionnaire explaining how the visit went and what you observed whilst you were there. You are then reimbursed up to your allowance, which is explained before you go, and paid an additional payment on top of that.

How much am I paid per job?

The payments per job vary based on how long the assignment may take and how much is involved, you will be emailed all the detail including the amount being offered for payment for each job and then you choose to accept the job if you wish. You will be paid a minimum of $20 per job up to a maximum of $150

How many jobs do I have to do?

You can choose to do as many or as few as you like, you are not obligated to do a specific number so you get to choose the ones you really want. 

How many jobs can I expect?

There are no guarantees of any number of jobs as it all depends on the areas you have chosen to work and the clients we are working with at the time. You will be alerted by email when jobs become available. If you wish to make Mystery Shopping a regular part of your income then we suggest you register with a few agencies so you have a regular flow of work. – This is not a position that you would be able to make what you might refer to as a ‘normal full time wage’. It is a position that you would do to earn extra cash to supplement your current role, or as a part time hobby.

How am I paid?

After your report has been accepted by our QA team you will be paid within 14 days, straight into your nominated bank account. 

How do I find out about jobs? 

You will be emailed about jobs that become available in your chosen areas.

Do I need an ABN number? 

An ABN number is a great idea to have if you are looking to do Mystery shopping on a regular basis, alternatively, if it suits your personal tax situation you can send us a completed ‘Statement By Supplier’ form that you can download from the ATO website.  

Will I be an employee of Secret Customer Australia? 

No, you will a subcontractor and therefore must sort out your own tax at the end of the financial year.

1.	Follow this link and register your details on the Secret Customer website https://secret-customer-pty-ltd.clients.app.praemialis.com/registration

2.	Complete the four very simple compliance tests located in the members areas of the website, all tests must be passed at 100% and can be taken as many times as you like.

Senior Project Manager - HV Infrastructure and Energy Projects     Location:  Sydney, NSW , Australia   About The Role:     Randstad has been engaged to recruit a talented  Senior Project Manager . The client has a strong presence in the energy sector in Australia and has a strong pipeline of projects with a mix of substations, transmission lines, and renewable energy projects (wind, solar, BESS).    As a  Senior Project Manager    you will:  
 
  Manage project budgets, timelines, and deliverables  
 Build & maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, sub-contractors, suppliers, and other project partners 
 Prioritise quality, safety and HSEQ standards 
 Provide technical and site leadership across engineering, procurement, and construction 
 Lead projects from conception through to commissioning and handover 
 Lead end-to-end project execution, project leadership 
 
  Experience:  
 
 Proven expertise in project management in the energy sector (HV infrastructure, utilities, renewable energy) 
 P&L Accountability 
 Proven experience delivering HV infrastructure and large-scale EPC projects. 
 Experience managing sub-contractors, stakeholders, client relationships, contract management 
 Strong commercial, analytical, and problem-solving skills 
 Strong leadership abilities 
 Ability to manage and deliver projects on time/budget 
 Experience with grid connection, SCADA, commissioning activities, and other related activities 
 
  Qualifications:  
 
 Degree in Engineering, Construction, or other closely related discipline 
 10+ years in Project Management 
 Background in delivering large-scale utility and renewable energy projects 
 Project Management certification highly desirable (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) 
 
  What's In It For You:  
 
  Long term stability with a strong pipeline of exciting projects  
 A client with a strong brand in the market and trusted in delivery large-scale utilities and renewable energy projects 
 Career growth, performance-based incentives, and a strong collaborative and highly capable team/environment.  
 
To apply to this  Senior Project Manager  role: click apply or send a CV to danielle.jacobson@randstad.com.au

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

Explore a world of career opportunities with us across every state of Australia, including New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, the Australian Capital Territory, and the Northern Territory. Join our dynamic team today and start your journey in the state that feels like home.

Offshore Staff Assist is currently hiring for a broad range of positions across various sectors on behalf of our client. We recognize your enthusiasm for becoming a part of our team and are keen to support your professional development. Our focus on excellence and innovation is at the core of our business, offering a solid foundation for your skills to develop and succeed. 
We are not just offering jobs, but long-term career opportunities that promise growth and advancement within the company and into Australia. If you're looking for a role where your contributions are valued and your professional growth is a priority, please join us to build a future where your career aspirations align with our commitment to progress and hard work.
We're currently looking for qualified:

•	Metal Fabricator
•	Welder 
•	Sheet Metal Trades Worker
•	Vehicle Body Builder
•	Fitter and Turner
•	Fitter-Welder
•	Pressure Welder 
•	Metal Machinist 
•	CNC Machinist

To be considered for the below roles, you must have a minimum 3 years’ experience.

Metal Fabricator
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in interpreting engineering drawings and blueprints, coupled with a solid understanding of metal properties and machinery. Your role will involve cutting, bending, and assembling metal structures and equipment through the use of welders, cutters, shapers, and measuring tools. You will be responsible for producing metal products according to clients specifications. Attention to detail, precision, and a safety-first attitude are paramount for success in this role.

Welder
Experienced and proficient Welder to become part of our welding department. This position demands proficiency in using various welding techniques (MIG, TIG, MMA) and equipment to join, surface, fabricate, and repair parts of metal or other weldable materials. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail, with extensive knowledge of welding procedures and safety measures. You will work on a variety of projects, ensuring that final products meet the highest quality standards and are completed within the designated timeline.

Sheet Metal Trades Worker

We require Sheet Metal Trades Workers that can study blueprints, drawings and specifications to determine job, material and equipment requirements. Select metal stock, such as stainless steel, galvanised iron, mild steel, aluminium and copper, and checking sizes, gauges and other dimensions of metal stock against specifications. Mark out metal stock with reference points and lines, using templates, gauges and other measuring instruments. Cut metal stock along guidelines using hand and power shears, guillotines and drills

Vehicle Body Builder

We are looking for Vehicle Body Builders that can manufacture and repair prototype production units and purpose-built vehicle bodies such as buses, trucks, fire engines and caravans. Constructing framework sections in metal wood fibreglass and other materials using shaping machines and cutting and welding equipment. Cutting and shaping panels of Sheetmetal aluminium and reinforced plastic and attaching to frameworks using hand and power tools

Fitter and Turner
Join our dynamic team as a Fitter and Turner, where you will be responsible for fabricating, fitting, and machining mechanical parts to assemble or repair mechanical systems. The role demands precision and attention to detail, with extensive knowledge of machine operation and material properties.

Fitter-Welder
We require a skilled Fitter-Welder to carry out both fitting tasks and welding operations according to project needs. Candidates should have proficiency in various welding techniques and the ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings. Experience in metal fabrication and a keen eye for quality are essential.

Pressure Welder
We are looking for a specialised Pressure Welder to support our operations with expertise in high-pressure vessels and piping . The role requires advanced knowledge and experience in welding processes that are crucial for the integrity of pressure vessels, boilers, and high-pressure piping systems. Candidates must possess the ability to read and interpret blueprints and standards related to pressure welding, ensuring compliance with both internal and external regulations and standards. This position demands high precision and adherence to strict safety and quality controls.

Metal Machinist
In this role, you will operate and maintain a variety of machines to produce precision parts and instruments. Key responsibilities include interpreting drawings, setting up mills and lathes, and conducting tests on completed tasks to ensure they meet specifications. The ideal candidate will have a comprehensive understanding of metal properties and machining techniques, combined with problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

CNC Machinist
This role involves programming, setting up, and operating CNC machines to produce high-quality parts and tools from metal, plastic, or other materials. The successful candidate will have in-depth knowledge of computer numerical control (CNC) machinery operations and processes, as well as an understanding of CAD/CAM software. Precision, attention to detail, and the ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and blueprints are essential. You will be instrumental in ensuring that our production goals are met with efficiency and high standards of quality.

Ararat Family Restaurant is a 24-hour full-service restaurant that offers well-priced hearty breakfasts, lunch, and la carte dinners with a seating capacity of more than 120 patrons. We are committed to providing the best culinary experience and maintaining the highest hygiene standards. This is a rare opportunity to work in a rewarding environment as part of a creative kitchen brigade.

About the Role

The restaurant provides breakfast, lunch, dinner and a function menu filled with colourful, nutritious, and organic fare 7 days a week.  The Chef position intends to lead the restaurant kitchen in cooking food, creating, and cooking meals unique to the restaurant. The primary objective of the role is to prepare uniform dishes and be responsible for maintaining a safe and healthy work environment. We are currently seeking a Chef (for a full-time position) which is critical to our ability to operate the business.

Job Description

Position: Chef
Location of work: 8475 Western Hwy, Ararat VIC 3377
Employment type: Permanent, Full time
Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000 plus Guranteed Superannuation

The main duties of the position include: 
     
•	Coordinate & participate in the cooking and preparation of all the food items present in the restaurant’s menu.
•	Assist with planning tasks and building food menus in the restaurant.
•	Planning menus, overseeing the kitchen staff, and ensuring that the food meets high-quality standards.
•	Ensure that each dish is nutritious, and cost-effective and collaborate with a team of kitchen staff to deliver food that meets the highest quality standards.
•	Taking stock of ingredients and equipment and placing orders to replenish stock.
•	Coordinating kitchen staff and assisting them as required.
•	Training staff to prepare and cook all the menu items.
•	Setting up the kitchen with cooking utensils and equipment like knives, pans, and food scales.
•	Slightly modify recipes to meet customer’s needs and requests.
•	Ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations within the kitchen area.
•	Ensuring impeccable presentation and garnishing.
•	Make sure that other kitchen staff that work under him adhere to standards of cooking.
•	Able to initiate new ideas in cooking methods to bring up fresh and attractive ideas that will generate more sales.
•	Strictly adhere to the budget of the restaurant by ensuring that supplies are in line with the budget and supervising food and labour costs.
•	Monitor and maintain stock levels to place orders for supplies when due.
•	Monitor and oversee sanitation practices to ensure that regulations and standards of cleanliness are always being strictly adhered to by employees.
•	Managing relationships with distributors and resolving any issues with vendors, promptly.

•	Balances nutritional value of menus and ensures the quality of the total service program.
•	Interact with the guests to receive their feedback on food quality, service levels and presentation.
•	Aware of control of substances hazardous to health and chemical safety.
•	Review staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
•	 Ensuring that the food items are stocked properly in refrigerators and freezers.
•	Conduct menu abstract analysis and engineering functions to improve profit and quality.
•	Evaluate changes in guest needs, the guest mix, industry, and competitive trends.
•	Make sure adequate numbers of kitchen staff are scheduled to handle each banquet properly.
•	Possesses the ability to handle any menu ranging from breakfast buffets to corporate lunch meetings with sandwiches to formal dinners that are individually plated.
•	Be able to express creativity through food selections, preparation, and presentation.

Key attributes/ Skills:
•	Communication
•	Leadership
•	Interpersonal skills. 
•	Capable of delegating multiple tasks.
•	Excellent record of kitchen management. 
•	Excellent time management skills. 
•	Perfection in sanitation and quality control. 
•	Knowledge of all safety standards.  

 Interested in the role? Apply for the role if you think you meet the criteria, and we’ll get in contact with you shortly. Only eligible candidates will be contacted.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our elite sales team is made up of passionate, dedicated professionals, delivering the most advanced medical technologies to patients in need. By collaborating extensively with leading healthcare professionals you’ll see first-hand the impact you have on individual lives - one patient at a time. 

The position of Clinical Specialist, Electrophysiology (EP), provides field/remote clinical, technical & educational support in EP to assigned accounts across ANZ. The primary focus is to support new therapy introduction of Pulsed Field Ablation through our recent launch of the FARAPULSE™ system, demonstrating clinical expertise to influence superior outcomes. Frequent travel will be required as part of the role. 

The Clinical Specialist – Electrophysiology role is based in New South Wales and reports to the Field Clinical Specialist Manager.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•	Utilising your technical knowledge of:
o	The field of electrophysiology (including propagation of electrical circuits within cardiac tissue and the pathophysiology of electrical rhythm disorders), biophysics of radiofrequency, cryo-thermal ablation, 2D and 3D electroanatomical mapping principles to provide:
?	Clinical support including basic trouble-shooting, and clinical guidance to diagnose and treat cardiac arrhythmias
?	Provide the measurement of electrical circuits within the heart and perform stimulation protocols as per physician requests to measure the electrical conductivity of the heart to aid in the diagnosis of cardiac arrhythmias
?	Develop a deep technical understanding of, and provide the technical training of company products to Cardiac Electrophysiologists, Cardiac Physiologists and Nurses
•	Travelling as required to meet customer demand for the services described above.
•	Attending cases face to face (or remotely) with customers, operating Boston Scientific products where appropriate, and providing detailed training / advice to physicians on clinical attributes / techniques associated with Boston Scientific electrophysiology products including:
o	Providing clinical support for: FARAPULSE™, OPAL™, RHYTHMIA™, LAB SYSTEM PRO™, MAESTRO 4000™, METRIQ™, plus support for the full range of Boston Scientific EP Catheters

Secret Customer Australia is a National Mystery Shopping and Market Research Company! We already have thousands of happy shoppers but need more in Surry Hills, NSW and all surrounding suburbs.

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra cash while out and about doing the things you love. Many of our shoppers work with us on a part time basis whilst working their normal jobs while others make a career out of Mystery Shopping by registering with us and other agencies.  The skills you need are simple: 

- A genuine desire to help improve the level of Customer Service in Australia.
- Access to a computer and/or tablet with internet access.
- Intermediate computer skills
- Great attention to detail
- Good memory skills
- Good English writing skills

These particular assignments we are hiring for at the moment are for the Retail Industry  and we have them regularly,  you can do as many or as little as you like.

We do have other industries that we work for such as:

- Hospitality
- Retail Clothing
- Real Estate
- Administration
- Not for Profit
- Hairdressing
- Beauty Salons 
- Retail Flooring
- Outdoor Adventures
- and many many more...

Join the team today and help us make the world a happier place!... yes seriously, that's what we do...  

Join the team and experience the fun and rewarding industry that is mystery shopping! 

We have an online application process we would like you to follow in order to register with us and then be able to start accepting assignments. 

What is the next step?

There are four simple steps to becoming a shopper with us...

1.	Follow this link and register your details on the Secret Customer website https://secret-customer-pty-ltd.clients.app.praemialis.com/registration

2.	Complete the four very simple compliance tests located in the members areas of the website, all tests must be passed at 100% and can be taken as many times as you like.

3.	You will then be emailed instructions on how to complete the online virtual visit using our online reporting system.

4.	Once you have submitted this report it will be reviewed and if accepted you will be sent an email explaining what to do to allow you to start accepting jobs online! If you have any further questions you can call us on 1300 88 33 16 or email us at enquiries @ secretcustomer.com.au 

If you are still not sure, here are some FAQ that may be useful to you:

Why become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra income whist doing the things you already do and enjoy. Your assignments might be to visit a local café or restaurant, cinema, local attraction or another local business. You simply visit your chosen location as you would as a normal paying customer, once you have finished your visit you fill out an online questionnaire explaining how the visit went and what you observed whilst you were there. You are then reimbursed up to your allowance, which is explained before you go, and paid an additional payment on top of that.

How much am I paid per job?

The payments per job vary based on how long the assignment may take and how much is involved, you will be emailed all the detail including the amount being offered for payment for each job and then you choose to accept the job if you wish. You will be paid a minimum of $20 per job up to a maximum of $150

How many jobs do I have to do?

You can choose to do as many or as few as you like, you are not obligated to do a specific number so you get to choose the ones you really want. 

How many jobs can I expect?

There are no guarantees of any number of jobs as it all depends on the areas you have chosen to work and the clients we are working with at the time. You will be alerted by email when jobs become available. If you wish to make Mystery Shopping a regular part of your income then we suggest you register with a few agencies so you have a regular flow of work. – This is not a position that you would be able to make what you might refer to as a ‘normal full time wage’. It is a position that you would do to earn extra cash to supplement your current role, or as a part time hobby.

How am I paid?

After your report has been accepted by our QA team you will be paid within 14 days, straight into your nominated bank account. 

How do I find out about jobs? 

You will be emailed about jobs that become available in your chosen areas.

Do I need an ABN number? 

An ABN number is a great idea to have if you are looking to do Mystery shopping on a regular basis, alternatively, if it suits your personal tax situation you can send us a completed ‘Statement By Supplier’ form that you can download from the ATO website.  

Will I be an employee of Secret Customer Australia? 

No, you will a subcontractor and therefore must sort out your own tax at the end of the financial year.

## Penetration Tester
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and driven Penetration Tester to join our cybersecurity team and play a critical role in identifying and addressing vulnerabilities across our systems, networks, and applications. In this role, you will design and execute comprehensive penetration testing engagements, simulate real-world cyber threats, and deliver actionable insights that strengthen our security posture. The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, a methodical approach to problem-solving, and a passion for ethical hacking and offensive security practices.
## Key Responsibilities
- Develop, plan, and execute penetration testing methodologies across networks, web applications, cloud environments, and internal infrastructure to uncover security weaknesses before they can be exploited
- Design detailed test cases through in-depth technical analysis of risks, common vulnerability patterns, and threat intelligence relevant to the organisation's environment
- Produce comprehensive test scripts, materials, and testing packs to evaluate both new and existing software, services, and systems for security vulnerabilities
- Plan and conduct cyber threat emulation activities — including adversary simulation and red team exercises — to validate the effectiveness of technical security controls and identify gaps in defences
- Identify exploitable vulnerabilities and map potential attack vectors into systems, analysing scan results and manual findings to assess the severity and risk of security loopholes
- Carry out social engineering assessments, including simulated phishing campaigns, to evaluate the effectiveness of security awareness programmes and staff resilience to human-focused threats
- Perform thorough post-engagement analysis and produce clear, well-structured reports that communicate technical findings and risk ratings to both technical teams and senior stakeholders
- Provide prioritised, practical remediation recommendations and work collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to support the resolution of identified vulnerabilities
- Stay current with emerging attack techniques, exploit research, CVEs, and evolving threat landscapes to ensure testing methodologies remain effective and up to date
- Support certification, accreditation, and compliance activities by providing security assurance testing aligned with relevant frameworks and regulatory requirements
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal security testing processes, tooling, and documentation to enhance the team's overall capability and efficiency
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Demonstrated experience in penetration testing, ethical hacking, or a closely related offensive security role
- Proficiency with industry-standard penetration testing tools such as Metasploit, Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Cobalt Strike, or similar
- Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems (Windows and Linux), web application architectures, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
- Practical knowledge of common vulnerability frameworks and standards, including OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, CVE, and CVSS
- Experience conducting vulnerability assessments, threat modelling, and risk analysis across varied technical environments
- Ability to write clear, professional reports tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences, articulating findings, risks, and recommended remediation actions
- Solid understanding of security principles, defence-in-depth strategies, and secure development practices
- Relevant industry certification such as OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional), CEH, or equivalent
- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with meticulous attention to detail
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements simultaneously and work effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced certifications such as OSCE, OSEP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CREST-accredited qualifications
- Experience with red team operations, purple team exercises, or adversary simulation engagements
- Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Ruby for custom tool development and automation
- Exposure to ICS/SCADA, IoT, or operational technology (OT) security testing environments
- Experience working within regulated industries or environments subject to frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, or the Australian Government Information Security Manual (ISM)
- Knowledge of cloud-native security testing techniques and containerised environment assessments
## Why Join Us?
- Work on technically challenging and varied engagements across diverse industries, giving you genuine breadth of experience and ongoing professional growth
- Access a structured professional development budget to pursue advanced certifications, attend industry conferences, and build on your existing skill set
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options, that support a healthy work-life balance
- Be part of a collaborative, high-performing security team that values knowledge sharing, innovation, and a strong ethical approach to cybersecurity
- Contribute to meaningful work that directly protects organisations and individuals from real-world cyber threats
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Location: 		Arundel, QLD, 4214
Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Reports to:		Workshop Foreman / Production Manager
Job Title: 		Carpenter
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 days

About the Role:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a meticulous and experienced Carpenter with specialized expertise in fine cabinetmaking and custom joinery. This is a full-time, permanent position based in their modern Arundel workshop. The successful candidate will be integral to transforming architectural concepts into tangible, heirloom-quality installations. You will report directly to the Workshop Foreman and collaborate with a team of dedicated craftspeople and designers.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Design Interpretation & Material Preparation:
• Accurately analyse and interpret detailed technical drawings, CAD designs, and shop plans for custom cabinetry, complex joinery, and freestanding furniture.
• Plan and sequence the workflow, meticulously selecting appropriate timber species, veneers, laminates, and composite materials to meet exact design specifications and project timelines.

Precision Machining & Fabrication:
• Expertly operate a range of hand tools, power tools, and advanced workshop machinery including panel saws, thicknessers, routers, and CNC equipment to cut, shape, and prepare components.
• Fabricate bespoke cabinets, shelving units, countertops, and architectural millwork with exceptional attention to detail, adhering to tolerances within 1mm variance.

Expert Joinery & Component Assembly:
• Execute and implement advanced joinery techniques such as dovetail, mortise-and-tenon, and domino joinery to ensure both structural integrity and aesthetic appeal.
• Assemble components using specialized adhesives, fasteners, and clamping systems, guaranteeing seamless alignment, perfect squareness, and flawless integration of all parts.

Finishing, Detailing & Hardware Application:
• Skilfully apply veneers, laminates, and edge-banding to achieve invisible seams and pristine surfaces.
• Perform multi-stage sanding, staining, sealing, and finishing processes to produce a superior final coat as per client specifications, including matte, satin, or gloss finishes.
• Precisely install and calibrate high-end hardware such as soft-close hinges, drawer runners, and custom handles to ensure flawless operation and functionality.

Quality Assurance & Workshop Excellence:
• Conduct rigorous quality inspections of both raw materials and finished products, ensuring strict compliance with design intent, safety standards, and the company’s renowned quality benchmarks.
• Proactively identify and troubleshoot construction or fit issues, implementing effective corrective measures with a solutions-oriented mindset.
• Maintain a clean, safe, and highly organized workshop environment in line with 5S principles and all Work Health & Safety (WHS) regulations, including strict adherence to PPE protocols.

Skills & Experience Required:
Essential Qualifications & Experience:
• A formal qualification such as a Certificate III in Cabinet Making or Carpentry is essential.
• A minimum of 2 years of proven post-apprenticeship experience within a high-end commercial joinery, cabinetmaking, or furniture manufacturing workshop.
• Demonstrable portfolio showcasing experience with solid timber, veneers, and engineered board products.

Technical Proficiencies:
• High competency in traditional and modern joinery methods, precision machining, and hand-finishing techniques.
• Proven experience safely operating and performing basic maintenance on workshop machinery, including CNC routers and panel saws.

Personal Attributes:
• An unwavering eye for detail and a deep-seated pride in producing work of exceptional craftsmanship.
• A self-managed, proactive work ethic with strong problem-solving abilities and the initiative to work independently.
• Excellent communication skills and a collaborative spirit to work effectively with designers, project managers, and fellow tradespeople.
• The physical capability to perform manual tasks, including lifting materials up to 25kg, and standing for extended periods in a workshop setting.

What’s On Offer:
This is a exceptional opportunity for a passionate carpenter to advance their career with an industry leader. You will be provided with a permanent full-time role, a competitive remuneration package commensurate with experience, and the chance to work on prestigious projects with premium materials. You will join a supportive, skilled team in a well-resourced, modern facility.

Application Process:
If you are a craftsman dedicated to excellence and your skills align with this specialist role, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience through the provided application portal. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.
We are acting as an exclusive recruitment partner for this position. Please note that our client's company name has been withheld as per our agency agreement.

result.description:
## Cyber Security Operations Coordinator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Cyber Security Operations Coordinator to lead the coordination and response to complex cyber security incidents, threat hunting investigations, and cross-functional security operations. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding organisational systems and data by driving incident response activities, advising leadership on operational matters, and contributing to strategic security planning. The ideal candidate is a technically proficient security professional with strong coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgement, and the ability to communicate complex security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
## Key Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end investigation and response to cyber security incidents, including containment, mitigation, and recovery activities, ensuring timely resolution and minimal operational disruption
- Direct threat hunting operations to proactively identify threat vectors, develop threat models, and build security cases that inform defensive strategies across the organisation
- Analyse security risks, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats, translating findings into actionable security plans and technical controls aligned with the organisation's security architecture
- Coordinate and manage tasks across multiple teams during incident response and threat hunt engagements, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and effective workflow throughout each operation
- Advise senior leadership on the status of current security operations, ongoing collaborations, and key findings, contributing meaningfully to strategic security planning and policy development
- Develop and communicate key messaging around security incidents and threat intelligence, ensuring accurate and timely information is delivered to the appropriate stakeholders
- Oversee the collection, preservation, and forensic analysis of digital evidence in accordance with established procedures and chain-of-custody requirements
- Implement and maintain technical security controls that align with the organisation's security strategies, frameworks, and compliance obligations
- Perform ongoing threat management activities, monitoring threat landscapes and updating security models to reflect evolving attack techniques and adversary behaviours
- Facilitate and coordinate security awareness training programmes for staff, promoting a security-conscious culture across the organisation
- Maintain detailed records of incident response activities, investigation findings, and operational outcomes to support continuous improvement and audit readiness
- Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to uphold the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of organisational systems and information assets
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security operations, incident response, or threat intelligence role, with exposure to coordinating cross-functional teams
- Strong working knowledge of incident response methodologies, threat hunting techniques, and digital forensics processes
- Experience conducting security risk assessments, vulnerability analyses, and developing actionable remediation plans
- Proficiency with security tools and platforms such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and threat intelligence feeds
- Solid understanding of security frameworks and standards, including NIST, ISO 27001, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Demonstrated ability to analyse and interpret complex technical information and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Strong project coordination and task management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure environment
- Sound understanding of network security, endpoint protection, identity and access management, and cloud security principles
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing professional reports, briefings, and incident documentation
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, GIAC (e.g. GCIH, GCFA), or CompTIA Security+
- Experience working within a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment or managed security services setting
- Familiarity with Australian regulatory and compliance requirements, including the Privacy Act, Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, and relevant sector-specific obligations
- Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, malware analysis, or reverse engineering
- Experience contributing to the development of security policies, procedures, or organisational security awareness programmes
- Prior experience briefing or advising senior leadership or executive stakeholders on cyber security matters
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking security team where your contributions directly shape the organisation's cyber resilience
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, including hybrid work arrangements
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, reflective of your skills and experience
- Work within a values-driven organisation committed to innovation, integrity, and building a diverse and inclusive workplace
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

How many jobs do I have to do?

You can choose to do as many or as few as you like, you are not obligated to do a specific number so you get to choose the ones you really want.

After your report has been accepted by our QA team you will be paid within 14 days, straight into your nominated bank account. 

How do I find out about jobs? 

You will be emailed about jobs that become available in your chosen areas.

Do I need an ABN number? 

An ABN number is a great idea to have if you are looking to do Mystery shopping on a regular basis, alternatively, if it suits your personal tax situation you can send us a completed ‘Statement By Supplier’ form that you can download from the ATO website.  

Will I be an employee of Secret Customer Australia?
